style: Cozy editorial book illustration in the style of a modern picture book: soft gouache and grain texture, flat organic shapes with gentle shading, muted warm palette (deep plum night, terracotta, mustard, sage, cream, warm candle gold). Festive New Year mood. Vertical 2:3 composition. The top 40% of the image is calm and simple (night sky, wall or snow) with no objects, so text can be placed there. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. No visible hands or fingers.

scenes.main: A cozy reading nook at night before New Year: a big arched window with falling snow outside, a soft armchair with a knitted plaid, a tall stack of books with a string of warm fairy lights wrapped around it, a cup of tea and a few mandarins on a small table, a ginger cat sleeping on the armchair. No people.
scenes.book: A single closed hardcover book lying on a wooden table, tied with a red ribbon like a New Year gift, surrounded by fir branches, a lit candle and a few mandarins, warm candlelight, snowy window in the background. No people.
scenes.pages: A giant stack of books shaped like a Christmas tree standing in a small snowy town square at dusk, decorated with fairy lights and a golden star on top, tiny silhouettes of people far away admiring it, warm lit windows of houses around.
scenes.month: A quiet snowy street at night with an old bookshop, its windows glowing warm and full of books, a fir garland over the door, snow falling, a lamp post. No people close up.
scenes.type: A magical winter night sky full of stars over snowy hills and small houses with lit windows, a large golden crescent moon, a tiny distant silhouette of a reader sitting on the moon with an open book, a few books flying like birds.
